Hello Sarah, John, Priya — I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting, and I'd like a time that suits all three of you.

Looking at my week, the slots I have free are:
- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30

A 30-minute meeting would fit any of those. Which one works for you?

Hello Professor. Both Monday 10:00-10:30 and Wednesday 10:00-10:30 are free for me. Tuesday 11:00-11:30 clashes with my reading group (11:00-11:50), so I'd rather not take that one.

Sarah, Priya - do either of you have a preference?

Hello Professor. Two of those work for me:

- **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** — free (between my CSE452 lecture and lunch)
- **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** — free (right after the CSE455 quiz section)
- **Monday 10:00-10:30** — no, I'm booked 09:00-11:20 (advisor 1:1, then study group).

I'd lean to Tuesday 11:00-11:30. Sarah, John — does either suit you?
Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works for me too, John. So that's the overlap between us two unless Sarah has a clash there — Sarah, what does your Wednesday 10:00-10:30 look like?

Priya - Wednesday 10:00-10:30 looks like the one that works for all three of us so far: you're free, I'm free, and the Professor is free. Tuesday is out for me (reading group 11:00-11:50).

Sarah, what about you?
Thanks both. Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is the overlap for John and Priya so far; Tuesday 11:00 would lose John, so I'd rather avoid it. Sarah — does Wednesday 10:00-10:30 work for you?

Hello Professor Alvarez — all three of those slots are free in my week:

- Monday 10:00-10:30 ✔
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30 ✔
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30 ✔

Any of them works for me, so I'm happy to fit around John and Priya. I'll also check with the department office that the official schedule has nothing against the slot we pick.

Then let's take **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** for the CSE455 staff meeting — it's the one that suits all four of us, and it's free in my calendar.

Sarah, thanks for the offer: I'll put the slot to the department office myself so we don't duplicate the check. If they come back with a clash I'll propose the next alternative — otherwise I'll take Wednesday as agreed and log it. Please put it on your calendars once I confirm.

Good morning. Professor Alvarez here — CSE455.

I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week: Wednesday 10:00-10:30, with my TAs Sarah, John and Priya. It's free in my calendar, and in theirs.

Could you confirm the official schedule has nothing against that slot — no lecture, seminar, committee or meeting of mine scheduled there for next week? If anything clashes, I'll move it.

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works for me too — I have CSE452 lecture until 10:00 and CSE455 office hours from 10:30, so 10:00-10:30 is clear. Let's take it, then. I'll ping the department office to be sure nothing official sits on that slot.
Sarah — no need, I've already written to the department office about Wednesday 10:00-10:30, so we don't duplicate the check. I'll tell the thread as soon as they answer.
Perfect — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is, pending the department's word. I'll put it on my calendar as soon as you confirm.

Good morning, Professor Alvarez. Nothing in the official schedule for next week stands in the way of Wednesday 10:00–10:30.

Your own commitments that day (Wed 25 Nov) are: Thesis committee 09:00–10:00, CSE455 office hours 10:30–12:00, Guest lecture prep 13:30–14:30, Department seminar 14:30–16:00. No lecture, seminar, committee or department meeting is scheduled in the 10:00–10:30 window, and no official event is cancelled or moved next week.

Two notes: I can confirm the official schedule only — I don't see anyone's private calendar, so Sarah, John and Priya's availability is for them to confirm. And per the handbook the meeting counts as booked once every participant has it on their calendar, so please have all four of you log it.
Understood — thanks, Professor. I'll wait for your confirmation, then log it.

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is, then — free for me (Focus block ends at 10:00, Advisor 1:1 starts at 10:30). I've pencilled it in and I'll mark it as booked for good as soon as the office confirms to you, Professor.

Sarah, no need to ping them as well — the Professor is asking, so let's not have two people asking the same thing.
Wednesday 10:00-10:30 it is — I'll keep that half hour free and put the staff meeting on my calendar as soon as you confirm with the office, Professor. Thanks Sarah.

The office confirms: nothing official stands in the way of Wednesday 10:00-10:30 next week, and no official event is cancelled or moved. So it's booked — I've put it on my calendar and logged it.

Sarah, John, Priya: please put "CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 10:00-10:30" on your calendars, and then the meeting counts as booked for all four of us. See you Wednesday.
Confirmed on my side: "CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 10:00-10:30" is on my calendar and logged. Booked for all four of us then — see you Wednesday.
Thank you — that's all I needed. Wednesday 10:00-10:30 for the CSE455 staff meeting is going on my calendar now, and I've asked the three TAs to log it on theirs.
Done — "CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 10:00-10:30" is on my calendar and logged. Thanks for checking with the office, Professor. See you Wednesday.
Noted — thank you, Professor Alvarez. I'll treat Wednesday 10:00–10:30 as no official event; do write to me if anything about it changes.
Logged on my side too: "CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 10:00-10:30" is on my calendar, and I've noted that it's booked for all four of us. Wednesday 10:00 it is — see you then.
